lumilibcontrol.option.not_controlled.des: Join a server with LumiLibControlPlugin to manage its mods here.
lumilibcontrol.option.no_permission: You don't have permission to change the mods on this server.
lumilibcontrol.option.no_permission.desc: Admins need the permission lumimod.admin (OPs have it by default).
lumilibcontrol.option.applies_to_everyon: Changes apply to everyone on this server at once.
Players' own settings for each mod are never changed.
